parameters.jsCode: const crypto=require('crypto');const fail=(statusCode,error)=>[{json:{ok:false,statusCode,error}}];const authorization=$json.headers?.authorization??'';if(!authorization.startsWith('Bearer '))return fail(401,'Sesión requerida.');const secret=$env.JWT_SECRET;if(!secret)return fail(500,'El servicio no está configurado.');try{const[header,payloadPart,signature,extra]=authorization.slice(7).trim().split('.');if(!header||!payloadPart||!signature||extra)throw new Error();const expected=crypto.createHmac('sha256',secret).update(`${header}.${payloadPart}`).digest('base64url'),left=Buffer.from(signature),right=Buffer.from(expected);if(left.length!==right.length||!crypto.timingSafeEqual(left,right))throw new Error();const payload=JSON.parse(Buffer.from(payloadPart,'base64url').toString('utf8'));if(!payload.exp||payload.exp<=Math.floor(Date.now()/1000))throw new Error();const role=String(payload.rol??'').toUpperCase(),permissions=(Array.isArray(payload.permisos)?payload.permisos:[]).map(String);if(role!=='ADMINISTRADOR_PARKING'&&!permissions.includes('parqueadero.gestionar'))return fail(403,'No tiene permisos.');const body=$json.body??{},identification=String(body.identification??'').trim(),fullName=String(body.fullName??'').trim(),institutionalEmail=String(body.institutionalEmail??'').trim().toLowerCase();if(String(body.type??'').toUpperCase()!=='INVITADO'||body.sourceId!=null)return fail(400,'Desde el panel sólo se registran invitados.');if(!/^\d{10}$/.test(identification))return fail(400,'La cédula debe contener exactamente 10 dígitos.');if(fullName.length<3||fullName.length>150||!/^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$/.test(institutionalEmail))return fail(400,'Complete correctamente el nombre y el correo.');return[{json:{ok:true,type:'INVITADO',identification,fullName,institutionalEmail,sourceId:null,panelUserId:Number(payload.uid??payload.sub)}}];}catch{return fail(401,'La sesión es inválida o ha vencido.');}
